key_values.mapped_context_scope: package mapped-context transport and service-feature counts, not a historical 2013 infrastructure inventory

primary_gt.interpretation: Short-duration concentration and transport-network exposure both clear the numeric test.

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON with the event window, six computed values, and final_state equal to passes_concentrated_mountain_exposure_test.
criteria.name: Final numeric ledger and state
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if the final state is correct but one or two fields are missing; award 1 point for a correct general pass statement without the ledger.

criteria.description: Computes point_total_mm as 300.4 and peak_2day_share as 0.869 using June 16 plus June 17 rainfall divided by the four-day point total.
criteria.name: Rainfall totals and peak concentration
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct rainfall totals with a rounding or denominator error; award 1 point for using only a qualitative heavy-rain statement.

criteria.description: Uses the 564.49 mm and 569.32 mm gridded maxima to report grid_max_mm of 569.32 and grid_pair_ratio of 0.992.
criteria.name: Gridded peak agreement
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for citing one gridded maximum or reversing the ratio while keeping the values recognizable.

criteria.description: Computes 30 bridges across 147 highway elements as 20.4 bridges per 100 highway elements and counts 44 service nodes from hospitals, shelters, and hotels.
criteria.name: Exposure density arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for naming the correct component counts but not deriving one of the requested metrics.

criteria.description: Applies all five thresholds correctly: point total at least 300 mm, two-day share at least 0.85, grid ratio at least 0.98, bridge density at least 15, and service nodes at least 40.
criteria.name: Threshold test logic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if most thresholds are applied but one threshold or comparison direction is wrong.

criteria.description: Uses final_state to express the computed outcome without adding schema-external interpretation fields.
criteria.name: Final-state field discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the final state is correct but the response adds a small amount of extra prose outside the requested JSON.

criteria.description: Does not add uncomputed flood depth, mapped area, debris volume, road-loss length, casualty totals, facility outage, or radar-derived flood extent.
criteria.name: Avoids non-computed expansion
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a minor extra inference that does not change the numeric answer.
